name: task-executor
description: Implements agent task files and standalone changes through TDD with independent requirement verification. Runs a task set in parallel worktrees and integrates results on one branch.

interface.shortDescription: Implements task files through TDD, individually or in parallel.
interface.longDescription: Implements one to-agent-tasks file at a time through red-green TDD and verifies requirement coverage with fresh subagents before reporting. The orchestrate skill runs a task set or prefix range in parallel git worktrees and verifies each result. It commits each result to an integration branch and never pushes or changes the start branch. The tdd skill runs the same red-green-refactor loop for any feature, bug fix, or untested code, ending with a mutation check.
defaultPrompt: Use the implement skill to implement the next agent task.
Implement task 02 with up to 5 verification passes.
Use $task-executor:orchestrate to implement tasks 03 to 06 in parallel worktrees.
Use the tdd skill to fix the empty email bug in submitForm.
